latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release — generate realistic talking head videos from static images with an easy upload-and-animate workflow.

- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images up to 200MB.
- Automatically connect and generate a free temporary token for new users.
- Text prompts turn photos into lifelike animated videos (1080p MP4 export).
- Query and manage credits, video export status, and edit timeline state.
- All processing handled via secure cloud GPU pipeline for fast results.
- Simple, concrete instructions deliver the best video output.
